items.title: Recompilation: An Incredible New Way to Keep N64 Games Alive
items.description: Introduces static recompilation through the Majora's Mask recompile project and credits the project developers for technical explanations and footage.
items.source_evidence: The video description introduces static recompilation and says the project developers provided technical explanations and footage.
items.recommendation_rationale: An approachable overview with strong visible YouTube engagement and technical context from the project developers.

items.title: The Legend of Zelda - Ocarina of Time has been FULLY decompiled | MVG
items.description: Examines Ocarina of Time's decompilation into human-readable C code and explains how the project works.
items.source_evidence: The video description says the episode looks at the Ocarina of Time decompilation into human-readable C and how the process works.
items.recommendation_rationale: A concrete, widely viewed decompilation walkthrough from a verified retro-gaming channel.

items.title: N64: Recompiled
items.description: The project README explains how N64 binaries are split into functions and translated instruction by instruction into C, including metadata requirements and examples.
items.source_evidence: The maintainer README describes binary-to-C static recompilation, the instruction translation process, and the symbol/build metadata the tool needs.
items.recommendation_rationale: A primary-source technical explanation of the recompiler used by current N64 native-port projects.
items.popularity_evidence: The GitHub repository page displayed 8.3k stars on the checked date.

items.title: Shipwright (Ship of Harkinian)
items.description: The README describes Ocarina of Time's native port, its dependence on the decompilation source, the modern libultraship layer, and its Direct3D 11, OpenGL, and Metal rendering backends.
items.source_evidence: The project README says Ship of Harkinian uses the Ocarina of Time decompilation and libultraship, and lists Direct3D 11, OpenGL, and Metal backends.
items.recommendation_rationale: A primary project reference that connects decompiled source to a native port, platform services, and graphics backend choices.
items.popularity_evidence: The GitHub repository page displayed 5.6k stars on the checked date.

items.title: DXVK
items.description: The README describes DXVK as a Vulkan-based translation layer for Direct3D 8 through 11 on Linux with Wine and documents setup, shader behavior, and DXVK Native for ports.
items.source_evidence: The README identifies DXVK as a Vulkan-based Direct3D 8/9/10/11 implementation for Linux and Wine, and explains DXVK Native's use in ports.
items.recommendation_rationale: A primary technical source for the Direct3D-to-Vulkan layer used in Proton-style compatibility stacks.
items.popularity_evidence: The GitHub repository page displayed 18.3k stars on the checked date.
